en.title: Tools — exact-length background music
en.description: Generate royalty-free background music at an exact length — 15, 30 or 60 seconds — loop-ready, with stems and a commercial license. Built for video editors, podcasters and game developers.
en.lede: A royalty-free track at exactly the length you need — 15, 30 or 60 seconds. Loop-ready, stem-separated, with a commercial license included.

steps.p: Pick a mood, a tempo and a length — or drop in an image and let it set the tone.
A few seconds later you get a track that starts and ends exactly where your cut does.
WAV, MP3 and separated stems, with a license you can hand to a client.

en.note: In early development. The first tracks will be free — write to us and we will let you know the moment the generator opens.
